mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.hose_code, SUM(p.length_m) AS total_length_m, COUNT(*) AS piece_count, MAX(p.length_m) AS max_length_m, GROUP_CONCAT(CAST(p.length_m AS DECIMAL(8,1)) ORDER BY p.length_m DESC SEPARATOR '+') AS piece_text, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(l.location_code, ' ', IFNULL(l.location_name, '')) SEPARATOR '、') AS location_names FROM wms_hose_piece p LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id WHERE p.status = '在库' GROUP BY p.hose_code ) st ON st.hose_code = s.hose_code
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.hose_code, s.bore_code, s.layer_code, s.inch, s.nickname, s.layer_name, s.id_mm, s.od_mm, s.work_pressure_mpa, s.bend_radius_mm, s.cost_price, s.price_source, s.std_ref, s.remark, IFNULL(st.total_length_m, 0) AS total_length_m, IFNULL(st.piece_count, 0) AS piece_count, IFNULL(st.max_length_m, 0) AS max_length_m, st.piece_text, st.location_names FROM wms_hose_spec s
AND (s.hose_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.inch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.layer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND st.piece_count > 0
ORDER BY CAST(s.bore_code AS UNSIGNED), s.layer_code

SELECT s.id, s.hose_code, s.bore_code, s.layer_code, s.inch, s.nickname, s.layer_name, s.id_mm, s.od_mm, s.work_pressure_mpa, s.bend_radius_mm, s.cost_price, s.price_source, s.std_ref, s.remark, IFNULL(st.total_length_m, 0) AS total_length_m, IFNULL(st.piece_count, 0) AS piece_count, IFNULL(st.max_length_m, 0) AS max_length_m, st.piece_text, st.location_names FROM wms_hose_spec s
WHERE s.hose_code = #{hoseCode}
